format: Existing case_blocks_v1 common-base fixed-offset byte blocks, through archive_case/restore_case. No new format, SHA or fingerprint validation. Existing primitive verifies every reconstructed byte before removing a working case.
workflow: Explicit archive_lme_cases after matching prediction and scoring drivers are terminal. Complete inventory of all attempted runtimes, including failures, must match directories. Shared templates and all prediction/scoring/cohort files stay retained. Source runtime path now recorded before retrieval so its first failure has a declared location.
restoration: archive_lme_cases.py restore PREDICTIONS ROW restores original runtime path without overwriting an existing case. Existing generic restore_case_archive.py supports explicit archive/base/destination. Retain unchanged shared templates; archive is not standalone. Restore observations outside runtime keep restored bytes identical.
case_boundaries: Archive and restore index preserves actual prediction/scoring status and full planned count. Running stages, wrong cohort, unknown/missing runtimes and overlap with retained base reject before removal. Partial archive failures retain index and existing primitive evidence; no automatic retry.

validation.scope: Real temporary Store, complete mocked native prediction/scoring, full-file roundtrip including failed Reader/retrieval and untouched unattempted tail, bases/outcomes unchanged; live/missing/unlisted/base-overlap boundaries. No actual research model calls.

full_store_probe: Two independent complete preflight runtime copies, add one explicitly synthetic Source only to each case copy, retain exact expected copies, archive/restore using existing primitive and compare every file byte. No fabricated benchmark prediction/score status, no original Store changes.
costs: Archive/restore CPU/wall reported separately from prediction/scoring and never automatically settled. Full-store probe pending; nested subclocks not added again. No prior research cases deleted or rewritten.
